verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents an AI Agent chat panel that creates, edits and enhances content across Guides, API References and Custom Pages. Inline AI accepts plain-language instructions on selected text and applies the edits. Linter rules are written in natural language and run per page or site-wide via Docs Audit. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands extend beyond content editing to product operations such as settings, publishing, branching or configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the Agent works as described.
